properties.name: loop_status warm answers in at most 2,000 ms
properties.statement: A warm loop_status - the ONE CHEAP CALL cap:loop-status promises every session will run - answers in at most 2,000 ms. Derived: the orientation call may cost no more than the single most expensive DERIVED fact it reports, computed once; that fact is detect_gaps at ~1.5 s. Measured 2026-09-05 before any change: 12,502 ms warm on the live store, release. Composed of open_defects 5.8 s (uncached, run for a count), sync-target reads 3.6 s (five dead /tmp exports), detect_gaps 1.8 s, other ~1.3 s. Anthony accepted 2026-09-05. Bounds: release, this machine, live store, stdio - the shared-daemon path is slower still. An aspirational floor of 1,000 ms applies if detect_gaps is also shared across rollups.
